lcc_original: 瑪土撒拉生拉麥之後，又活了七百八十二年，這期間還生兒養女。
notes: 並且 (UNV connective) → 這期間還 (LCC): LCC expands with '這期間' (this period) and '還' (also/still) — neither carries a Hebrew SN in UNV, so left unannotated; SNs for 生兒養女 attach normally

First <WH08141> kept implicit {<WH08141>} between 百 and 八十: Hebrew numeral formula שֶׁבַע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה repeats שָׁנָה (year) after 'hundreds,' which has no explicit Chinese counterpart in either UNV or LCC
{<WAH0853>} retained as implicit: Hebrew direct object marker את has no explicit Chinese word in LCC
